body_html:
DJ Joe Lockwood

Born and raised in Tampa, Florida, DJ Joe Lockwood has been bringing the beats and energy to dance floors since 2013! With over eight years of experience, Joe knows exactly how to keep the crowd moving and the good vibes flowing.

From weddings and hip-hop showcases to all kinds of variety events, Joe’s versatility and passion shine through every performance. His love for music started when he first picked up a Paul Oakenfold album, and he’s been hooked ever since!

What Joe loves most about being a DJ:
“Seeing everyone dancing, smiling, and having the time of their lives and hearing all the thank-yous at the end of the night!”

In Joe’s headphones: SIDE2SIDE by Nikko (but he listens to just about everything).
Dance floor favorites: “One More Time” by Daft Punk, “MUTT” by Jun Tanaka, and “B.O.B (Bombs Over Baghdad)” by Outkast.

When he’s not behind the decks, Joe loves producing house and hip-hop music and spending time with his girlfriend, dog, and cat. No matter the event, DJ Joe Lockwood brings the music, the energy, and the fun leaving every crowd smiling and wanting more!
